translations.web: The incense which you shall make, according to its composition you shall not make for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
translations.asv: And the incense which thou shalt make, according to the composition thereof ye shall not make for yourselves: it shall be unto thee holy for Jehovah.
